Verify.title: How we verify organizations
Verify.lead: The Verified badge marks nonprofit immigration organizations that meet ImmiMap's review standards. We publish these criteria so families and advocates can understand what the label means — and what it does not.
Verify.badgeTooltip: This nonprofit provides active immigration legal or social services and has passed ImmiMap's verification review.

criteria.title: Verification criteria
criteria.intro: An organization receives the Verified badge only when it meets all of the following standards. Law firms and private practices are listed separately and are not eligible for this badge.

nonprofit.title: Recognized nonprofit or legal aid status
nonprofit.description: The organization operates as a registered nonprofit, accredited legal aid provider, or equivalent publicly recognized immigration support entity — not as an unregulated immigration consultant or fee-for-service scam operation.

activeServices.title: Active immigration services
activeServices.description: The organization currently offers immigration legal representation, case assistance, or direct social services to immigrant communities. Defunct programs, placeholder listings, or organizations outside immigration work are not verified.

contactInfo.title: Confirmable contact details
contactInfo.description: Public contact information — including address, phone number, and website — is current and matches what appears on the organization's official channels or government registries.

publicRecord.title: Alignment with public records
publicRecord.description: Listing details are cross-checked against authoritative sources such as IRS nonprofit records, state bar or legal aid directories, and Department of Justice recognition lists where applicable.

manualReview.title: Manual ImmiMap review
manualReview.description: Every Verified organization is individually reviewed by the ImmiMap team before the badge is applied. Automated data alone is not sufficient for verification.

process.title: Our review process
process.description: Verification is performed during initial cataloging and re-checked during regular data refreshes. If an organization no longer meets these standards, the Verified badge is removed until the listing is corrected or reconfirmed.

limitations.title: What Verified does not mean
limitations.description: A Verified badge is not a guarantee of case outcome, attorney-client relationship, or availability for new clients. It indicates that ImmiMap has confirmed the organization's nonprofit standing and active immigration services at the time of review. Always contact the organization directly to confirm intake status, eligibility, and fees.

questions.title: Questions about a listing?
questions.description: If you believe a Verified badge was applied in error or an organization no longer meets these standards, contact us at lichoiyin@gmail.com. We review all good-faith reports and update listings when evidence supports a change.

Home.heroSubtitle: A visual directory of NGOs and legal aid across the US. Designed for accessibility, powered by open data.
Home.heroBody: ImmiMap helps families, advocates, and community organizations find credible immigration support faster. Start with location, service type, and price filters, then compare providers without losing context.

howItWorks.title: Three steps from search to support
howItWorks.description: The experience is designed to reduce friction for people who need help quickly while still giving advocates enough context to make a confident referral.

location.title: Filter by Location

connect.title: Connect with Help

About.title: Reliable immigration support should be easier to find.
About.lead: ImmiMap is a public-interest directory for immigration legal aid, nonprofit support, and transparent USCIS processing information.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We help immigrants, families, and advocates locate trustworthy services with less guesswork. The goal is simple: make the first step toward qualified help clearer, faster, and more accessible.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: The project began as a response to scattered provider lists, outdated contact details, and confusing public data. ImmiMap brings these signals into one focused interface built for real community use.

transparency.title: Data Transparency
transparency.description: Provider and processing-time data is modeled so each record can be traced, refreshed, and reviewed. Current demo data is clearly labeled, and the system is ready for verified source pipelines.

Join.pageLead: We are currently recruiting for two core volunteer positions to help scale our platform. Review the roles below and submit your application.

webDevelopment.title: Web Development
webDevelopment.description: Help build and maintain our React / Next.js frontend, optimize the map architecture, and ensure the platform remains fast and accessible.

socialMedia.title: Social Media
socialMedia.description: Lead our community outreach. Create technical and editorial content to spread awareness, and engage directly with the immigrant and legal aid communities.
